title: schoenus cygneus
intro: Schoenus cygneus, commonly known as Swamp Sedge, is a perennial plant species belonging to the sedge family (Cyperaceae). This plant is valued for its traditional use in treating various health conditions, including fever and respiratory issues, due to its health benefits such as reducing inflammation and acting as an expectorant. The therapeutic actions of Schoenus cygneus include its antimicrobial and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its wound healing and anti-inflammatory effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant are primarily composed of sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
